description: This file defines the 'Blip' class, representing an image data block within the Escher DggContainer's BSE hierarchy in PhpSpreadsheet. It includes methods for managing raw image data and its parent BSE reference.

classes.name: Blip
classes.description: Represents an image (bilevel picture) data object within the Escher drawing container structure, handling raw image data and linkage to its parent BSE.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the raw image data stored in this Blip instance.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the raw image data for this Blip instance.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Associates this Blip with its parent BSE object.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent BSE object associated with this Blip.
